subject: Startups
title: Jawbone: Hardware Graveyard
description: A micro-lesson that makes Jawbone: Hardware Graveyard usable.

hook.text: Jawbone raised $930 million and was valued at $3.2 billion. It made fitness trackers. Then it made nothing.

buildup.text: Jawbone's UP band competed with Fitbit. Quality issues, product delays, and returns plagued every launch.

discovery.text: Hardware unicorns face a brutal reality: each product launch is a bet.

twist.text: Jawbone sued Fitbit for stealing trade secrets.

climax.text: Jawbone liquidated in 2017. $930 million in VC money gone. Investors received pennies on the dollar.

punchline.text: In hardware, one flop can kill a billion-dollar company.

quiz.question: How much did Jawbone raise before liquidating?
